author: Diego Muñoz
title: Diego Muñoz collection record for moai kavakava

claims.value: According to the Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa “this moai kavakava is one of the earlier documented figures of its type, having reached England in 1828 or 1835. It is thought to have been collected during F. W. Beechey’s expedition in HMS Blossom in 1825.”
